parameter_matrix.note: Synchronous rectification eliminates external Schottky diode loss and PCB area.
Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Provides transient overshoot margin above nominal DC supply bus.
Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning up to switch BVdss limits.
For boost/switch-limited converters, usable Iout ≈ Isw × (Vin / Vout) × η minus half ripple ΔIL/2.
Dominates light-load efficiency and standby battery runtime.
Higher fsw shrinks inductor footprint; lower fsw reduces switching losses & high-band EMI.
Check datasheet efficiency curve at your exact Vin/Vout/Iout operating point.
Ensure inductor Isat exceeds worst-case peak switch current by >= 20–30%.
Any Vref discrepancy requires recalculating feedback divider R1/R2.
Lower θJA improves continuous load thermal headroom on compact 2-layer PCBs.

swap_risks: CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS61040DBVR specifies 400 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS61041DBVR 250 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5). Remember boost/switch-limited Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle and inductor ripple scaling.
BENCH VERIFICATION: Confirm thermal dissipation margin using θJA (TPS61040DBVR: 205.2 °C/W vs TPS61041DBVR: 205.2 °C/W) and worst-case ambient temperature (-40..85 °C vs -40..85 °C).
engineering_verdict: TPS61040DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS61041DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because current rating or switch-limit basis differs. Power-stage deltas: boost (non-sync) vs boost (non-sync), switching frequency 1000 kHz (p.1) vs 1000 kHz (p.4) (1x ratio), typical inductor 10 µH (p.4) vs 10 µH (p.4), feedback Vref 1.233 V (p.5) vs 1.233 V (p.5), and package θJA 205.2 vs 205.2 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS61040DBVR "VIN Capped at 6.0 V (7.0 V Abs Max) vs Pin-Compatible 14 V LM27313/LM2733" (p.4) and TPS61041DBVR "Lower 250 mA Switch Limit (215 mA Min) & Higher 750 mOhm RDS(on) vs Pin-Identical TPS61040DBVR" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TPS61040DBVR when higher switch current capacity (400 mA) is required; choose TPS61041DBVR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-5 (DBV) qualification and -40..85 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
